formats.key: exactInputSingle((address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, address recipient, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMinimum, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96) params)
effects: The signer sends amountIn of tokenIn to the V3 pool. The router pulls it with transferFrom, or wraps native ETH instead when tokenIn is WETH and the router holds enough ETH.
The recipient receives at least amountOutMinimum of tokenOut from the pool, or the call reverts.
Native ETH sent with the call (payable) is used in place of WETH, or stays in the router when it is not used. Anyone can take it with refundETH.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer and 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
amountIn 0 swaps the router's own balance, so nothing is pulled from the signer.
A non-zero sqrtPriceLimitX96 can stop the swap early, so less than amountIn may be spent.
formats.shown: Intent 'swap' with the exact tokenIn amount sent, the minimum tokenOut to receive, the pool fee and the beneficiary. The price limit shows raw only when it is not zero.

findings.title: exactInputSingle is payable but no field shows the native ETH sent with the call.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputSingle is 'external payable'. PeripheryPayments.pay: 'if (token == WETH9 && address(this).balance >= value) { IWETH9(WETH9).deposit{value: value}(); ...'. The descriptor has no '@.value' field for exactInputSingle.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"@.value","label":"ETH sent","format":"amount"}. Unused ETH stays in the router, so also state that the call does not refund it.

findings.title: exactInputSingle shows recipient flags 0x…01 (signer) and 0x…02 (router) as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputInternal: 'if (recipient == Constants.MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender; else if (recipient == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);'. The 'Beneficiary' field has no senderAddress.
findings.fix: Add "senderAddress": ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001"] to the Beneficiary params. Also show 0x…02 as 'Router (output kept in router)'.

findings.title: exactInputSingle shows amountIn 0 as 'Send 0', but 0 means swap the router's balance.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputSingle: 'if (params.amountIn == Constants.CONTRACT_BALANCE) { hasAlreadyPaid = true; params.amountIn = IERC20(params.tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this)); }'. The 'Send' field is a plain tokenAmount.
findings.fix: Show amountIn 0 with a message such as 'Router balance', or add a label that names this case.

findings.title: exactInputSingle shows a non-zero price limit as a raw sqrtPriceX96 number, and that limit can cause a partial fill.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field 'params.sqrtPriceLimitX96' uses format 'raw' with visible mustMatch [0]. In V3SwapRouter.exactInputInternal, the pool swap stops at the price limit, so less than amountIn may be spent.
findings.fix: Label the field 'Price limit (swap may fill partially)', and change 'Send' to 'Send up to' when the limit is set.

findings.title: exactInputSingle tests cover only value 0 and a normal recipient. No test has ETH input or a flag recipient.
findings.evidence: Case 0: value '0', recipient 0xEceD…86a7. No case has non-zero value, recipient 0x…01 or 0x…02, or amountIn 0.
findings.fix: Add cases with msg.value > 0 and WETH as tokenIn, and with recipient 0x…01.

cases.notes: 6471375668623977 WETH out matches 'Send'. 13.971172 USDT in is at least the 13.901216 minimum. The beneficiary is the signer.

formats.key: exactOutputSingle((address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, address recipient, uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMaximum, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96) params)
effects: The signer pays tokenIn to the pool, at most amountInMaximum, by transferFrom, or with native ETH when tokenIn is WETH and the router holds enough ETH.
The recipient receives exactly amountOut of tokenOut when the price limit is 0. With a non-zero price limit it may receive less.
Native ETH sent with the call (payable) is used in place of WETH, or stays in the router. The call does not refund it.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer and 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
formats.shown: Intent 'Swap' with the maximum tokenIn spent ('Unlimited' above 2^255), the exact tokenOut to receive, the pool fee and the beneficiary. The price limit shows raw when it is not zero.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle is payable but no field shows the native ETH sent with the call.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputSingle is 'external payable'. PeripheryPayments.pay wraps router ETH when token == WETH9. The descriptor has no '@.value' field.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle shows recipient flags 0x…01 and 0x…02 as raw addresses, not as the signer or the router.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputInternal: 'if (recipient == Constants.MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender; else if (recipient == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);'. The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle labels the output 'Amount to Receive', but with a price limit the swap can deliver less.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputInternal: 'if (sqrtPriceLimitX96 == 0) require(amountOutReceived == amountOut);'. The price limit field is raw and shows only when it is not zero.
findings.fix: Label the price limit field 'Price limit (output may be less)'.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle tests have no case with non-zero ETH value or a flag recipient.
findings.evidence: Cases 1 and 2 both have value '0' and normal recipients.
findings.fix: Add a case with WETH as tokenIn and msg.value > 0, and one with recipient 0x…01.

cases.notes: 464757465845635 WETH out is within the 0.000509 WETH maximum. Exactly 0.0134 QNT arrives at the signer.

formats.key: swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path, address to)
effects: The signer sends amountIn of path[0] to the first V2 pair, or native ETH is wrapped when path[0] is WETH and the router holds enough ETH.
The recipient 'to' receives at least amountOutMin of path[-1], measured by its balance change.
Native ETH sent with the call (payable) is used in place of WETH, or stays in the router.
to 0x…01 means the signer and 0x…02 means the router; amountIn 0 swaps the router's balance.
formats.shown: Intent 'Swap' with the amount of the first path token sent, the minimum of the last path token received, and the recipient.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens is payable but no field shows the native ETH sent with the call.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens is 'external payable' and calls pay(path[0], ...). PeripheryPayments.pay uses router ETH when token == WETH9. The descriptor has no '@.value' field.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens shows 'to' flag 0x…01 (signer) as a raw address, with no senderAddress.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens: 'if (to == Constants.MSG_SENDER) to = msg.sender; else if (to == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) to = address(this);'. The Recipient field has no senderAddress, but the sibling swapTokensForExactTokens has one.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens shows amountIn 0 as 'Amount to Send 0', but 0 means swap the router's balance.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens: 'if (amountIn == Constants.CONTRACT_BALANCE) { hasAlreadyPaid = true; amountIn = IERC20(path[0]).balanceOf(address(this)); }'.
findings.fix: Show amountIn 0 with a message such as 'Router balance'.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens has one synthetic case with value 0, and no case for ETH input or flag recipients.
findings.fix: Add cases with msg.value > 0 and with to = 0x…01.

formats.key: swapTokensForExactTokens(uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMax, address[] path, address to)
effects: The signer sends the computed amountIn of path[0], at most amountInMax, to the first V2 pair, or native ETH is wrapped when path[0] is WETH and the router holds enough ETH.
The recipient 'to' receives amountOut of path[-1]. A fee-on-transfer output token delivers less.
Native ETH sent with the call (payable) is used in place of WETH, or stays in the router.
to 0x…01 means the signer and 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
formats.shown: Intent 'Swap' with the exact last path token amount to receive, the maximum of the first path token to send ('Unlimited' above 2^255), and the recipient (0x…01 shown as the sender).

findings.title: swapTokensForExactTokens is payable but no field shows the native ETH sent with the call.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapTokensForExactTokens is 'external payable' and calls 'pay(path[0], msg.sender, ...)'. PeripheryPayments.pay uses router ETH when token == WETH9. The descriptor has no '@.value' field.

findings.title: swapTokensForExactTokens shows 'to' 0x…02 raw, where the output stays in the router.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapTokensForExactTokens: 'else if (to == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) to = address(this);'. senderAddress lists only 0x…01.

findings.title: swapTokensForExactTokens tests have no case with ETH value or with recipient 0x…01.
findings.evidence: Cases 4 and 5 both have value '0' and to 0xd8dA…6045.
findings.fix: Add cases with msg.value > 0 and with to = 0x…01.
